title: cross-team-engineering-leadership-weekly-staff-notes-2026-03-02
body:
Cross-team Engineering Leadership Weekly — Staff Notes
Date: 2026-03-02
Facilitator: Aisha Patel
Attendees: Aisha Patel, Marco Ruiz, Lin Chen, Priya Nair, Ethan Brooks, Sofia Martinez, Noor Alvi (prod), Jordan Kim (SRE - on call)
Goals for this meeting:
- Quick sync across eng subteams on major risks, incidents, and upcoming rollouts.
- Surface cross-team blockers and assign owners for follow-ups.
- Confirm go/no-go timing for Dedicated capacity expansion and Private deployment test plan.

1) Quick highlights / housekeeping
- Congrats to Observability on GA of the per-route latency view (small rollout started last night).
- Security announced completion of quarterly key rotation dry-run (no customer impact).
- Hiring update: Platform has an offer out for a Senior Infra Engineer (expected start late March).

2) Incidents & on-call items
- INF-2345 (redis failover during burst test): Brief recap from Jordan — a combination of a replica lag spike and a read-promote timing bug caused a 5–7m window of elevated errors for background batch jobs. Mitigation: failover automation patched; root cause PR merged to infra repo (link in artifacts). Action: Marco to lead postmortem doc draft (owner Marco, due 2026-03-06).
- Observability alert storm during model rollout (2026-03-01): caused paging noise but no customer-facing errors. Action: Lin to tune alert thresholds for top 10 noisy alerts (owner Lin, due 2026-03-04).

3) Major cross-team projects
A) Dedicated capacity expansion (DED-102)
- Status: Final capacity sizing confirmed. Procurement completed for additional GPU nodes, expected provisioning week of 2026-03-09.
- Migration plan: non-customer-facing traffic will be routed to new pools first; gradual uplift over 2 weeks.
- Risks: autoscaler warm-up causing transient latency spikes. SRE/Serving-runtime to provide a canary ramp plan.
- Action items: Priya to own canary ramp plan with SRE (due 2026-03-05).

B) Private deployment (pilot customers)
- Status: Two pilot customers onboarded; first on-prem install completed in staging.
- Observed issues: KMS integration differences across customer HSMs surfaced; needs clearer KMS adapter interface.
- Action: Sofia (private deployments) to schedule API contract review with Security and Platform (owner Sofia, due 2026-03-09).

C) Serving runtime performance workstream
- Progress: continuous batching changes reduced median token latency by ~6% in internal perf tests.
- Kernel selection optimizer: prototype shows 8–12% throughput gain for long-sequence models; still unstable for certain quantized paths.
- Action: Marco + Lin to pair on failing quantized paths and produce instrumentation logs (owner Marco, due 2026-03-10).

4) Observability & Console
- New features: per-route cost breakdown is in beta. Early users report actionable savings suggestions.
- Concern: retention cost trade-offs for debug traces — Product to propose pricing/limits.
- Action: Product (Noor) to present proposed retention tiers at next staff meeting (owner Noor, due 2026-03-09).

5) Release engineering & rollout cadence
- Upcoming releases: Serving-runtime v1.9 scheduled for 2026-03-11; includes batching changes and kernel selection flags.
- Blocker: one high-priority regression in model loading (GH PR #421) is under review. If not merged by 2026-03-04, release will be delayed one week.
- Action: Ethan to coordinate urgent code review and testing (owner Ethan, due 2026-03-04).

6) Security & compliance notes
- Audit readiness: Security completed mapping of control objectives for Private deployments. No high-risk gaps identified.
- Note: customers requested SOC-like logs for dedicated pools; Product to scope as add-on.

7) Risks, open blockers, and escalations
- Risk: Autoscaler behavior under mixed-model workloads may cause capacity thrash when Dedicated pools scale down. Owner: Priya to run scenario tests and propose mitigation (due 2026-03-12).
- Blocker: KMS adapter spec needed before next Private pilot. Owner: Sofia (due 2026-03-09).

8) Decisions made
- Proceed with Dedicated capacity provisioning on 2026-03-09, contingent on canary ramp plan acceptance.
- Delay Serving-runtime v1.9 release if PR #421 not green by COB 2026-03-04.

9) Action item summary (owners + due dates)
- Marco: Postmortem draft for INF-2345 (due 2026-03-06).
- Lin: Alert tuning for noisy observability alerts (due 2026-03-04).
- Priya: Canary ramp plan for Dedicated expansion (due 2026-03-05).
- Sofia: KMS adapter API contract review (due 2026-03-09).
- Marco + Lin: Instrumentation for quantized kernel failures (due 2026-03-10).
- Ethan: Expedite code review + testing for GH PR #421 (due 2026-03-04).
- Noor (Product): Retention tier proposal for console debug traces (due 2026-03-09).

10) Parking lot (topics to pick up next week)
- Cost-optimization playbook for customers moving from hosted to dedicated.
- Long-term autoscaler policy research (multi-model fairness).
- SRE proposal for daytime maintenance windows to reduce paging.

Next meeting: 2026-03-09 (same time).
Notes prepared by: Aisha Patel.
Document status: in_review — please add comments in the Confluence thread or Slack #eng-staff.
